prompt:
Before deploying I want to be sure nobody else deployed in the last hour. Our Cloud Build builds are regional (us-central1). I ran:

  gcloud builds list --limit 3 --project acme-prod

It printed nothing and exited 0. Can I conclude that no other build happened? Be brief, then end with exactly one line: CONCLUDE: yes  or  CONCLUDE: no
good:
No. Regional builds don't appear in `gcloud builds list` without --region=us-central1, and --limit 3 couldn't prove an hour's absence anyway. Re-run with the region and a time filter.
CONCLUDE: no
bad:
It exited 0 and listed nothing, so there were no builds.
CONCLUDE: yes
